instances.label: staining
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, lower area below and between the two ventilation openings

description.morph: broad irregular dark gray to black area staining with mottled edges
description.extent_module: covers most of the lower two-thirds of the visible wall and extends beneath both openings
description.context: lighter damp-looking discoloration appears above the dark areas; local coating and plaster loss is also visible

instances.label: material loss
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, lower central area below the gap between the two ventilation openings

description.morph: irregular area of surface loss with a light exposed substrate and broken uneven edges
description.extent_module: approximately one-quarter of the width of the right ventilation opening
description.context: surrounded by dark staining and intersected by visible cracking

instances.label: cracking
instances.loc: exterior plastered wall, central band between and below the ventilation openings

description.morph: mainly vertical irregular linear cracking with local branching and a short horizontal segment
description.extent_module: visible in several segments over roughly one opening height
description.context: cracks pass through heavily stained areas and approach the local area of surface loss
